Faq.heading: Answers, before you ask
Faq.subheading: The things contractors, developers and homeowners ask us most.

range.a: Nine product lines covering every stage of construction — PVC pipes & fittings, polyethylene tanks, water pumps, ceramic sanitaryware, hot water systems, mining pipes & tools, and more.

delivery.a: We supply across Mwanza, Dar es Salaam and upcountry Tanzania, with stock depth to support multi-month projects without stock-outs.

quality.a: Yes. We source to international standards (BS EN ISO 1452, ASTM D1785, TZS 476) with test certificates, and replace any non-conforming product free of charge.

bulk.q: Do you offer bulk pricing for developers and contractors?
bulk.a: Yes — we provide competitive project quotations and bulk rates for large-scale and multi-phase procurement.

quote.q: How do I get a quote?
quote.a: Send your requirements via the contact form, email sales@zongii.co.tz, or call +255 769 005 007 — we respond within one business day.

hours.a: Our Pamba Road branch in Mwanza is open Monday to Friday, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm EAT.

About.heading: Supplying Tanzania since 2002
About.lead: What began as a small specialist plumbing supplier in Mwanza has grown into one of Tanzania's most trusted names in building and construction materials.
About.bodyOne: Zongii Mining Co. Limited opened its doors in 2002. Over 22 years we've grown from a handful of plumbing essentials into nine distinct product lines spanning every stage of construction — serving more than ten industry sectors across the country.
About.bodyTwo: Our incorporation as a private limited company in 2009 formalised the trust our customers had placed in us from the very beginning. Today we're a fully registered entity with the Tanzania Revenue Authority and proud to stand behind everything we sell.
About.missionBody: We don't trade on price alone. Every product we stock is sourced from manufacturers who can prove quality, traceability and compliance — so you can specify with confidence.
About.credentials: Fully registered with the Tanzania Revenue Authority (TIN: 108-998-350) and compliant with the Tax Administration Act 2015.
